> Newsletter list with honeypot + per-email rate-limit + token-based unsubscribe + admin remove.

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add subscribers
# alias: npx rr add subscribers
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `email`, `newsletter`, `subscribers`, `convex`, `backend`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add subscribers`. Compose `subscribersTables` into root convex/schema.ts. Public form posts `api.features.subscribers.mutations.subscribe({ email, source, website })` — `website` is the honeypot, leave it `""` from the form. Render unsubscribe link `/unsubscribe?t=<token>` and call `unsubscribe({ token })`.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
